entities.summary: The Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics is a public university in Nanjing, Jiangsu, China. It is affiliated with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. The university is part of Project 211, Seven Sons of National Defence, and the Double First-Class Construction.
